intro: Six articles on network security, published between 12 April and 1 October 2026, cover a critical-severity CVE-2026-93952 with a CVSS score of 10 and CVE-2026-76504 at 9.8, alongside CVE-2024-2973. The reporting centres on critical infrastructure, enterprise networking, and government sectors, with the United States as the affected region. Across the tag, four articles address critical severity, one covers a medium-severity issue, and one is informational. The coverage spans the period from the first April report through the final October article.
